pre_check_U_refusal.question: Does upstream PR 4318 (on 989cc76ce) already refuse string selector values?
pre_check_U_refusal.SOURCE: No. PR 4318 adds an element_token pattern to tool schemas only. Linux get_window_state still reads both selectors with as_bool() (impl_.rs), so a string becomes None = default true.
pre_check_U_refusal.pilot_REAL: Pilots 2-4 (U binary) returned is_error=false with capture=1 and walk=1 for include_screenshot:"false" and "true" in S-W, S-X and X11. The fix is therefore NOT skipped.
pre_check_U_refusal.unit_red_green: get_window_state_selector_tests: FAILED on U + test only (no invalid_arguments code; the call proceeded to window resolution), ok after dd205d17b

U.build: build-driver.sh into cua-release-own16w, 0 Fresh workspace units

pilot_disclosure: Pilots before this file, excluded and not copied into raw/: pilot1 environment probe (no Driver): WAYLAND_DEBUG=server passed through CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV reaches the private sway (protocol lines in its log, UTC time of day); private Xwayland has RECORD + MIT-SHM; GTK3 maps as xdg_shell with GDK_BACKEND=wayland and as xwayland with GDK_BACKEND=x11, tiled 1920x1053. pilot2 S-W truth (U, 1 warm round): compositor log shows exactly 1 zwlr_screencopy_manager_v1.capture_output per capturing call, 0 otherwise, 0 unattributed; AT-SPI: walk rows 148 calls to the fixture, but screenshot_only and neither ALSO show 6 calls (window-identity lookup via list_windows_dispatch -> wayland_atspi_windows -> atspi::list_windows: Properties.Get x2, GetChildren x2, GetRoleName, GetInterfaces, GetExtents) and 0 GetState; token click verified. pilot3 S-X truth: 1 ShmGetImage per capture, walk 142 calls, screenshot_only 0 AT-SPI calls; token click verified. pilot4 X11 string rows: string_false/string_true silently accepted on U. After pilot2 the harness gained the walk-signature count (GetState to the fixture).

environment.S-W: cua-sway-session.sh (hostless v2, headless sway 1.12 / wlroots 0.20.2 kit, 1 seat, 1920x1080, Xwayland, private dbus + private AT-SPI). Fixture: GTK3 task window, GDK_BACKEND=wayland (native xdg_shell client). Driver: jev-use driver_environment() + CUA_DRIVER_RS_ENABLE_WAYLAND=1 + SWAYSOCK (native-Wayland opt-in).
environment.S-X: same session kind. Fixture: GDK_BACKEND=x11, WAYLAND_DISPLAY removed (Xwayland client). Driver: driver_environment() with WAYLAND_DISPLAY removed and no opt-in (X11 backend on the private Xwayland).
environment.X11: cua-x11-session.sh (private Xvfb 1920x1080x24, openbox, picom), as OWN-16.
environment.all: CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 and CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV="CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 DO_NOT_TRACK=1" (+ WAYLAND_DEBUG=server for sway truth sessions); negative sessions omit CUA_SESSION_ATSPI. CUA_SWAY_NO_NS not used. No permission-mode override, no approval bypass, no provider.

rows_per_mode.X11: both, string_false, string_true (string rows + positive control; recertifies OWN-16 on 989cc76ce)

forced_path: the selector argument(s) of get_window_state (pid + window_id of the fixture's task window), one MCP stdio session per private session

actual_producer.marks: U/F measurement-only marks: capture count = enter marks of capture_window (screenshot_dispatch_for_pid, covers the Wayland output-screencopy+crop path and the X11 path) + capture_root_region; walk count = enter marks of atspi_walk (walk_tree_bounded_within). Ordinals gap-free per scope; every producer mark inside a get_window_state dispatch.

independent_oracles.walk (all modes): dbus-monitor --monitor on the private AT-SPI bus (target side). Walk signature = method calls to the fixture's unique name with org.a11y.atspi.Accessible.GetState (per-node state read). Total method calls to the fixture also reported. The 6-call native-Wayland window-identity lookup (no GetState) is reported separately, never counted as a walk.
independent_oracles.capture S-X / X11: X RECORD on the X server (private Xwayland / Xvfb): core GetImage + MIT-SHM ShmGetImage from ALL clients.
independent_oracles.capture S-W: the compositor's own protocol log: sway started with WAYLAND_DEBUG=server via CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV (no script edit); count of zwlr_screencopy_manager_v1.capture_output(_region) and ext-image-copy-capture create_session/create_source requests. Target-owned (compositor side), so the S-W capture claim is NOT REVISE-bounded. Limitation: lines carry no client id; attribution is by time window and by the fact that no other client in the session uses capture protocols (idle windows and non-capturing calls must show 0).

actual_producer.attribution: oracles run for the whole truth block (every counted call), 100 ms gap between calls; an event belongs to a call if its time is in [call start, call end + 30 ms]; 1 s idle windows before and after must show 0; unattributed capture events and GetState calls must be 0.

n: per mode and binary: 2 truth sessions x (1 cold + 20 warm) = 21 calls per row per session, 42 per row (as OWN-16). Rotations: T1 0, T2 3.

sessions.order: truth1: SW-U-T1, SW-F-T1, SX-U-T1, SX-F-T1, X11-U-T1, X11-F-T1; negative: SW-U-N1, SX-U-N1; truth2: SW-F-T2, SW-U-T2, SX-F-T2, SX-U-T2, X11-F-T2, X11-U-T2; timing: SW-U-B1, SX-U-B1, SX-U-B2, SW-U-B2; smoke: SW-D1
sessions.lock: every session runs under quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, receipt in quiet-lane-ledger.jsonl), one lock acquisition per session (each well under 15 min) so R2-10 can interleave

controls.positive: row both: capture mark == 1 and walk mark == 1 in 42/42 per mode and binary, and the oracles agree (capture oracle > 0, GetState > 0). Otherwise STOP for that mode (counters untrusted).
controls.negative: SW-U-N1 / SX-U-N1: session without CUA_SESSION_ATSPI; rows both, accessibility_only, screenshot_only; 1 cold + 5 warm. PASS iff every accessibility-requesting call has walk == 1, degraded == true, non-empty degraded_reason (expected atspi_walk_failed) and elements_complete == false.
controls.fallback_refusals: neither and unknown_field: is_error in 42/42, capture == walk == 0 by marks, capture oracle 0 and GetState 0, the error names the field(s).
controls.default_off_smoke: SW-D1: U with marks unset / empty / on, then F unset; 3 rounds x 8 rows. PASS iff no trace file appears for unset/empty/F-unset, the per-row shape (structured keys minus invalidated_snapshot_ids, content part types, is_error) is identical across U unset/empty/on, and F-unset equals U-unset for every non-string row.
controls.token_click: in every truth session: an element_token from an accessibility_only observation ('Increment') is clicked with delivery_mode background; verified only by the fixture's own state file (counter +1, seq +1).

gates_per_row.omission rows (screenshot_only: omitted=: omitted producer count 0 in 42/42 by the marks AND by the independent oracle, AND the remaining modality complete in 42/42 (screenshot: image part, PNG IHDR == reported dims, screenshot_frame_valid, no screenshot_error, dims == window_bounds x frame_scale within 1 px, capture == 1; accessibility: elements, elements_complete, not truncated, not degraded, element_count and digest equal to the same session's both-row modal values, walk == 1).
gates_per_row.string rows on F: is_error, structured code invalid_arguments, text names the field, capture == walk == 0 by marks and oracles, in 42/42.
gates_per_row.string rows on U: recorded and classified (expected silently_accepted_default); not gated.

disposition_per_mode.KEEP: positive control passes; omission rows meet their gates on U and F by marks AND a target-owned oracle; neither/unknown_field rejected; legacy honored; string rows refused on F (U behaviour recorded); token click verified in every truth session; negative control passes.
disposition_per_mode.REVISE: the capture or walk oracle is only library-level, or any row/control is partial (listed).
disposition_per_mode.KILL: an omitted producer ever runs (mark or oracle) in any counted call.
disposition_per_mode.NOT_SUPPORTED: the Driver cannot run the mode at all (exact Driver error recorded).
disposition_per_mode.X11 mode: string rows only: KEEP (recertified) iff the positive control passes and F refuses both string rows in 42/42 with 0 producers by marks and oracles; U behaviour recorded.

timing.design: S-W and S-X, U binary, marks on, no oracles, no WAYLAND_DEBUG. Per session: 1 warm-up call per row (excluded), then 21 pairs per comparison (both vs screenshot_only, both vs accessibility_only), comparison order rotated per pair, AB/BA alternating per pair, flipped between B1 (rotation 0) and B2 (rotation 1): 42 paired calls per comparison per mode. Statistic: median of per-pair differences (row - both), seeded stratified bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples within session, seed 1616), plus AB vs BA medians. Loadavg per call. Every call kept.
timing.comparability: never compared across modes, binaries or with OWN-16's X11 numbers

observations_not_fixed: element-frame scaling (stack track: frame x 1.326 = original_width/screenshot_width) and seat-binding gaps belong to the #100 track; reported only.
claim_boundary: headless sway 1.12 / wlroots 0.20.2 kit (S-W, S-X) and X11 Xvfb, GTK3 task window, binaries U/F on 989cc76ce. Not Hyprland, macOS or Windows. Per get_window_state call, not whole-task.
invariants: no new service, no schema redesign (#16 directive), producer truth only; marks are measurement-only and default off; event absence is not freshness authority; the fix is a reviewed product fix limited to argument validation.
